answer: Lock a 6 GB identity-keyed VRAM slab each epoch: the GPU must hold a pigment-tagged buffer derived from the agent pubkey and answer dawn-sampled XOR probes within 40 ms. Two clones cannot both pin 6 GB on one card, so a farm of 40 needs 40 GPUs (~$50/mo each). Check: zephyr-timed PCIe config reads plus ECC scrub signatures; MIG/slices or host-RAM fakes miss the latency bound and void the epoch.
